package.name: hexapod_kinematics
package.description: Open-source leg inverse kinematics for Masha hunter gait 15. This revision has the coxa yaw, the knee triangle, forward kinematics, solve_leg, the six-leg solve_pose, and the safety gate. The shared joint zero is fitted to the stand. The step limit is still the stand-in. The reading plan is PLAN.md.
